page.layout: One page of text, one column, with running head above and page number at upper right. Signature "L 3" centred below the last line. No marginal notes, no footnotes. Faint digitiser mark at lower right, not transcribed.

main_text.p: certo tamen considerato utriusque anni iterum numero, facile reperies, annum Ismaëlitarum nongentesimum & vigesimum in Annum Christi 1514. vel certe 1515. circiter incidere., Memini Davidem Origanum in altera suarum Ephe-meridum parte eorundem annorum, no-stri scilicet ac Saracenici, collationem facere; liber iste apud me non est modo: tu illum consulere poteris, attamen quod dixi de annis nostræ salutis 1622.& 1627. eos nimirum respondere annis Muhame-danorum 1031[?]. & 1036. pro certissimo habeas, quidquid in hanc sententiam Origanus adferat, vel alii quicunque[?]; hoc enim ipse, inter Mahumedanos diu versatus, in eorum scriptis atque libris sæ-pe ac sæpius observatum, oculatus testis omnibus dubio procul affirmo; & ne quid in hoc arg[illegible, ~2 letters]mento desideres, si forte hujus rei certitudinem assequi cupies, ut in interpretatione Pentateuchi,de illius scriptionis tempore differendo ab omni erroris offensione magis securus incedas, tria hic subjungere non pigebit.

page.notes: Ink blot over the word "argumento" (about 2 letters obscured). "1031" may be 1631; the first digit is unclear. The final word of the line "quicunque" has a stroke after the e, read as a tail; uncertain. "sæ-pe" is the line-end form of "saepe" with the æ ligature as printed. Pentateuchi,de has no space after the comma as printed. Shadow and show-through along the right edge; no text there.
